skill_name: Generate a book summary of the novel Animal Farm.
workflow: Animal Farm is a satirical novella by George Orwell that uses animals on a farm to represent political figures and ideologies of the Soviet Union during the Russian Revolution. The majority of the animals on the farm, led by the pigs, overthrow their human caretaker, Mr. Jones, in a quest for freedom and equality.
